title: Burnt-Orange Cabinets for $89? Here's the Real Cost
description: I got quoted $5,000-$20,000 to replace my oak cabinets before finding the $89 cabinet paint kit behind this week's HGTV and Better Homes & Gardens burnt-orange cabinet trend. Here's what the kit actually includes, why it doesn't come pre-mixed in burnt-orange, how much a full kitchen really costs once you factor in a second kit, and what reviewers wish they'd known about cure time before starting. Tap through for the full cost breakdown and the exact products I used.

title: Oak Cabinet Makeover: $89 Kit vs $20,000 Replacement
description: Full cabinet replacement runs $5,000-$20,000 and professional refacing is $4,000-$10,000 — but an $89 cabinet transformation kit gets structurally sound oak cabinets to the same burnt-orange and terracotta tones for roughly 1-2% of that cost. I'm breaking down what's actually in the box, why the bonding coat needs custom tinting at the paint counter, how many coats it takes on oak, and the real cure time before you can use the kitchen normally again. Save this before your next quote.

title: Matte Black Hardware + Burnt-Orange Cabinets, Under $30
description: Doors are already off the hinges for cabinet paint cure, which makes this the cheapest possible window to swap hardware too. A 30-pack of matte black 5-inch pulls runs $26.99 and holds a 4.7-star rating across 38,159 reviews, with screw spacing that lines up with most existing pilot holes — no redrilling. It's the detail that makes a repainted cabinet read as a finished renovation instead of a paint job over old pulls. Full project cost and the exact pulls linked here.

title: Hide Cure-Time Cabinet Clutter: $25 Lazy Susan Fix
description: Cabinet paint cure takes anywhere from a few days to three weeks, and during that whole window the cabinet interiors sit fully emptied out on the counter anyway. That's the one point in a kitchen's life when organizing the corner cabinet costs zero extra disruption. A set of 4 non-skid 10-inch lazy susan turntables is $24.99 with a 4.7-star rating across 6,190 reviews — no installation, they just drop onto the shelf. Pairing this with a cabinet repaint on the blog.

title: Terracotta Cabinet Paint Kit: What Reviewers Actually Say
description: Before trying the $89 cabinet transformation kit behind this week's burnt-orange cabinet trend, I read through what people who'd already used it on oak actually reported: a strong solvent smell that needs real ventilation, bond coat that needs 2-3 thin coats instead of one heavy one, and full cure stretching 1-3 weeks even though it's dry to the touch in 2 hours. Here's the realistic timeline and total cost before you start your own oak cabinet repaint.
